text.en:
The municipality of Antipolo shall consist of the territory
heretofore comprised therein plus all the territory com-
prised in the sitios of Bulao and Mayamut, now claimed by
the municipality of Taytay, the jurisdiction over which is
at present the subject of litigation in the Court of First
Instance of Rizal between the said municipalities of Antipolo
The municipality of Taytay shall consist of the territory
heretofore comprised therein less the said sitios of Bulao
and Mayamut.
The transfer herein made shall be effective on April first,
nineteen hundred and thirteen.
W. CAMERON FORBES,
Governor-General.
